gloss: exclusive dealer; authorized retailer; specialty shop

definitions.gloss: exclusive dealer; authorized retailer; specialty shop
definitions.explanation: A shop that has exclusive or authorized rights to sell certain brands or products in a particular area.

examples.japanese: この{商品|しょうひん}は{専売店|せんばいてん}でしか{買|か}えない。
examples.english: This product can only be bought at an exclusive dealer.

examples.japanese: {駅前|えきまえ}にブランドの{専売店|せんばいてん}がオープンした。
examples.english: A brand's exclusive retailer opened in front of the station.

examples.japanese: {地方|ちほう}の{専売店|せんばいてん}を{通|つう}じて{全国|ぜんこく}に{販路|はんろ}を{広|ひろ}げている。
examples.english: They are expanding their sales channels nationwide through regional exclusive dealers.

notes:
Composed of {専売|せんばい} (exclusive sale, monopoly sale) and {店|てん} (shop). Historically, Japan had a government monopoly system ({専売制度|せんばいせいど}) for products like tobacco and salt, with {専売店|せんばいてん} referring to shops licensed to sell those items. Today the term is mainly used for authorized brand retailers.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {正規|せいき}{専売店|せんばいてん} — authorized exclusive dealer
- {地域|ちいき}{専売店|せんばいてん} — regional exclusive dealer
- {専売店|せんばいてん}{契約|けいやく} — exclusive dealership agreement

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {直営店|ちょくえいてん} — directly operated store (owned by the brand itself)
- {代理店|だいりてん} — agent; distributor (sells on behalf of another)
- {特約店|とくやくてん} — authorized dealer; franchise dealer
